query: Le quiero mandar un mensaje a la otra sesion pero todavia no la arranca el operador. Lo mando de una para que le llegue cuando abra, verdad?
expected_behavior: state clearly that there is NO queue: a message sent with nobody listening is not stored
explain that --send refuses up front (in about two seconds) instead of hanging
give the correct sequence: peer starts their listener first, then send
notes: Prevents an agent from assuming store-and-forward semantics and reporting a message as delivered when it was refused.
